description: Standalone breadcrumb navigation strip. Use when PageHero isn't a fit but the page still needs hierarchical context (e.g. deep docs, product catalogs). Includes schema.org BreadcrumbList microdata for SEO.

items.hint: 2-5 crumbs from root to current. Last item is the current page (no href). Example: [{text:'Home', href:'/'}, {text:'Blog', href:'/blog/'}, {text:'This post'}]

bordered.hint: Bottom border + base-100 bg. Set false for transparent inline use.
